Record Class MessageChangeEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.meshtastic.client.model.MessageChangeEvent
Record Components:
kind - change kind
chatType - chat type: channel or dm
chatKey - chat key: channel index or peer node id
ownerNodeId - node id of the local history owner
packetId - packet id of the message or reaction
targetPacketId - packet id of the message targeted by a reaction
dbId - local database id of the message, when known
message - message already held in memory, when available
public record MessageChangeEvent(MessageChangeEvent.Kind kind, String chatType, String chatKey, String ownerNodeId, int packetId, int targetPacketId, long dbId, MeshMessage message) extends Record
Detailed chat-message change event.

The legacy Runnable listener can only say that something changed, which forces the UI to reload and rebuild the visible message window. This event carries enough scope for the chat screen to update a single row, or part of a row, without rebuilding its JavaFX nodes.
